newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin to leave hospital in a few days - Kremlin.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin to leave hospital in a few days - Kremlin.

text.p: Russian President Boris Yeltsin is likely to leave hospital in the next few days, Kremlin spokesman Sergei Yastrzhembsky told a news briefing on Friday.

"It (Yeltsin's departure from hospital) will be in the next few days, but not at the weekend," Yastrzhembsky said. Yeltsin, who is suffering from pneumonia, has been in hospital since Wednesday January 8.

Doctors had been reluctant to set a date for Yeltsin, 65, to leave the elite Central Clinical Hospital. They warned that pneumonia was a serious illness which carried the risk of possible complications.
But recent statements have had an optimistic tone, and doctors say the president's condition has stabilised.
"We have no reason to think that the doctors' optimism is unfounded," Yastrzhembsky said.

He added: "The president is certainly interested in recovering as quickly as possible. But I think it is natural to expect him to show some patience to give himself the chance of a recovering completely."
